task_statement: Provides a safe learning environment where all youth can explore and develop cognitive, social, emotional, and physical motor skills.
stem: A group of youth is building a fort using chairs, blankets, and cardboard boxes during free play. Some youth are climbing on chairs while others are becoming frustrated because they are not included. What should the staff member do first?
option_a: Stop the activity immediately and direct everyone to another activity.
option_b: Observe from a distance unless someone gets hurt.
option_c: Guide youth to use safe building methods while helping everyone participate respectfully.
option_d: Allow the youth to solve the problem independently without staff involvement.

task_statement: Communicates and follows emergency preparedness plans.
stem: During an after-school program, the fire alarm sounds unexpectedly. What is the most appropriate action for the staff member?
option_a: Wait to see if the alarm stops before reacting.
option_b: Follow the emergency evacuation plan and account for all youth.
option_c: Ask youth to gather their belongings before leaving.
option_d: Allow older youth to leave the building on their own.

task_statement: Practices emergency plans with the youth in care regularly.
stem: Several youth become confused during a tornado drill because they do not remember where to go. What should the staff member do?
option_a: Skip future drills because they upset the youth.
option_b: Review and practice the procedures regularly so youth become familiar with them.
option_c: Only explain the plan to new youth.
option_d: Assume youth will know what to do in a real emergency.

task_statement: Conducts regular indoor and outdoor safety checks; removes or repairs unsafe items; maintains safety and first aid supplies; and ensures materials and equipment are developmentally appropriate, well organized, clean, and in good repair.
stem: While supervising outdoor play, a staff member notices a broken swing chain on the playground. What is the best response?
option_a: Tell youth to avoid the swing but leave it available.
option_b: Remove access to the swing and report it for repair immediately.
option_c: Wait until the end of the week to report the issue.
option_d: Allow only older youth to use the swing carefully.

task_statement: Adheres to safety regulations and policies, including those regarding the inclusion of youth of all cultural backgrounds and abilities.
stem: A youth with mobility challenges wants to participate in a group game that involves running. What should the staff member do?
option_a: Exclude the youth to prevent slowing down the group.
option_b: Modify the activity so the youth can safely participate with peers.
option_c: Assign the youth to watch the game from the sidelines.
option_d: Let the youth decide whether to join without support or adaptation.

task_statement: Maintains appropriate staff-youth ratios and supervision in the facility, adapting for higher-risk activities.
stem: A staff member is supervising a swimming activity with a large group of youth. What is the most appropriate action?
option_a: Maintain the usual supervision ratio used during classroom activities.
option_b: Reduce supervision because lifeguards are present.
option_c: Increase supervision and position staff strategically because swimming is a higher-risk activity.
option_d: Allow strong swimmers to supervise younger youth.
